activity.text: Paste-and-review import of the club message: parser in src/import.js reads date, time window → duration, level, venue, numbered roster with (dupla) pairs; the new-tournament form fills in, Create signs everyone up. 27/27 tests.

Console restyled to Padel Buddy (palette + mark). Tournament page is four tabs (Board/Teams/Rounds/Table), Rounds is one form with Save all + per-match Save; empty boxes no longer coerce to 0-0. Settings tabbed too.

Round messages and Telegram. One message per round (court by court, who rests, one line per pair for where to go next) is posted to every group when the previous round's last score lands. src/messaging/ is a bus over a live Telegram channel and the WhatsApp draft outbox. TV view now shows the round actually being played. 24/24 tests.
Score entry rebuilt: each match is a form with one line per team and that team's score box on it; Save spans both. Old table column strings removed.

Board message rebuilt as a courts x 4 slot list driven by tournament settings; full EN/PT layer (src/i18n.js) across console, bot and errors; drop-out policy editable in both languages. 17/17 tests pass.
Added src/levels.js and src/dates.js, migrated tournaments to ISO date + time, rebuilt the console mobile-first, seeded Padel Tribe. 10/10 parser tests pass.

headline: Where do I go next — round messages in the groups, Telegram live
summary: The club's nights ran on a printed sheet and a PDF. Now the group gets one message per round saying who is on which court and where every pair goes next, posted automatically when the round before it is scored; !where Mike answers one person. Telegram posts by itself (bot token is the whole setup, the group is learned from the first command); WhatsApp stays a paste-from-outbox draft because it has no group API.
next: Confirm whether the club's level scale really runs to 9 (the message said "M9"); the ladder stops at 7 and the import leaves the level for the host to pick
